description.zh: 白板应用唯一标识符。获取AppID，请参见[CreateApp](~~204234~~)。
description.en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard application. To obtain the AppID, see [CreateApp](~~204234~~).

description.zh: 白板文档唯一标识符。获取DocKey，请参见[CreateWhiteBoard](~~204299~~)。
description.en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard document. To obtain the DocKey, see [CreateWhiteBoard](~~204299~~).

description.zh: 白板录制Session的唯一标识符。获取RecordId，请参见[StartWhiteBoardRecording](~~253300~~)。
description.en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard recording session. To obtain the RecordId, see [StartWhiteBoardRecording](~~253300~~).

description.zh: 结束白板录制的用户ID（客户业务用户），由1~32位大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成。
description.en: The ID of the user (business user) who stops the whiteboard recording. The value is 1 to 32 characters in length and can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens (-).

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[StartWhiteBoardRecording](~~253300~~)启动白板录制。
# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为200次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342798~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Operation description
Before you call this operation, you must have called [StartWhiteBoardRecording](~~253300~~) to start whiteboard recording.
# QPS limit
A single user can call this operation up to 200 times per second. If the number of calls exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered, which may affect your business. Use this operation as appropriate. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~342798~~).
